breakpoints.note: First project-code consumption on the vulnerable path: the raw OCSP buffer pointer and byte count are copied into local datum `der`, establishing the exact attacker-controlled DER span later parsed into the crashing certificate path.

The vulnerable code never zero-fills `oid` before reading the algorithm OID and never writes an explicit terminator after the returned length. When the witness certificate's algorithm is RSA-PSS, the later fixed-string comparison can read the unwritten tail byte. The staged `fixed_commit` and bundled `patch.diff` do not touch this code path, so they do not document the actual repair for the witnessed crash.
